name: Chem Lab Renovation
brief: Renovate the second-floor chemistry teaching lab during the winter term. Strip the old fittings, remove two partition walls, rewire the lab with new power and data points, add plumbing for wet-lab sinks, install fume-hood ducting and fire safety, lay anti-static vinyl flooring, fit a false ceiling with LED lighting, and install new benches and storage. Needs a building permit and a fire inspection before handover. In-house works team plus contracted trades; the department wants the lab back for the new term, about fourteen weeks.

tasks.name: Strip old lab fittings and equipment
Install new power wiring and data points
Install fume‑hood ducting and fire safety systems
Install lab benches and storage cabinets
Final interior touch‑ups and snag fixing

risks.title: Permit approval delay
risks.cause: Building authority backlog during winter term
risks.event: Permit not approved by scheduled date
risks.effect: Start of demolition and construction schedule slips
risks.response: Submit application early, follow up weekly with authority, and prepare a contingency plan for alternative start dates

risks.title: Design drawing errors
risks.event: Design requires revision after schedule is drafted
risks.effect: Delay in finalizing detailed construction schedule
risks.response: Conduct a design review workshop with lab staff and supervisor before final sign‑off

risks.title: Asbestos discovered in partition walls
risks.cause: Legacy asbestos insulation in original walls
risks.event: Asbestos found during demolition of partitions
risks.effect: Specialist removal needed, delaying wall removal and reinforcement
risks.response: Commission an asbestos survey before demolition and have a licensed removal contractor on standby

risks.title: Electrical material delivery late
risks.event: Conduits and panels arrive one week late
risks.effect: Rewiring and fume‑hood ducting start later, pushing back related tasks
risks.response: Include penalty clauses in supply contract and identify an alternate supplier as backup

risks.title: Anti‑static vinyl flooring shortage
risks.cause: Vendor backorder on specialized flooring rolls
risks.event: Flooring material not delivered on time
risks.effect: Floor laying delayed, which holds up bench installation
risks.response: Order extra stock and confirm lead times with supplier; keep a short‑term local alternative on standby

risks.title: Carpenter labour shortage
risks.cause: High demand for carpenters during winter term projects
risks.event: Carpenter crew unavailable for three consecutive days
risks.effect: Delays to stripping, ceiling framework, flooring and bench installation
risks.response: Secure a backup subcontractor crew and cross‑train masons on basic carpentry tasks

risks.title: Fire safety inspection non‑compliance
risks.cause: Fire suppression system not fully integrated with new ducting
risks.event: Official fire inspector issues a non‑compliance notice
risks.effect: Rework of fire safety systems and delayed handover
risks.response: Perform an internal pre‑inspection checklist and mock test the system before the official inspection

risks.title: Scope creep – extra bench request
risks.cause: Department adds request for an additional bench after demolition begins
risks.event: New bench design and procurement added to scope
risks.effect: Extra installation time pushes back bench fitting and overall handover
risks.response: Use a formal change‑order process and include a schedule buffer for ad‑hoc requests

risks.title: Flooring adhesive cure delay due to humidity
risks.cause: Winter indoor humidity exceeds adhesive specifications
risks.event: Adhesive does not reach required strength in expected time
risks.effect: Floor cannot be walked on, delaying bench installation
risks.response: Select low‑temperature curing adhesive and monitor humidity, using dehumidifiers if needed

risks.title: Trade clash between electrical and plumbing routes
risks.cause: Conduit and pipe routes intersect in the false ceiling space
risks.event: Clash detected during installation of services
risks.effect: Re‑routing required, adding delay to wiring, plumbing and ceiling work
risks.response: Hold weekly clash detection meetings using BIM models and adjust routing before physical installation
